relations.text: 年次報告で、クラウド基盤などをAmazon Web Servicesなど第三者に依存していると述べている
relations.text_en: The annual report says it depends on third parties such as Amazon Web Services for cloud computing infrastructure

source.label: Atlassian 10-K
source.quote: Additionally, we depend on services from various third parties, including cloud computing platform providers (such as Amazon Web Services) and other hardware and software providers, as well as general internet availability, to maintain our infrastructure and distribute our apps, agents, and products.

relations.text: RovoとGoogle Workspace、Gemini Enterpriseの連携を深めると発表した
relations.text_en: Announced deeper integrations between Rovo, Google Workspace, and Gemini Enterprise

source.label: Atlassian 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: By bringing deeper integrations between Rovo, Google Workspace, and Gemini Enterprise, joint customers can access AI agents directly in the tools where they already work, plan, and collaborate on projects.

relations.text: Google Cloudとの戦略的提携を強め、Rovo向けにGemini 3 Flashを加えた
relations.text_en: Strengthened its strategic partnership with Google Cloud by adding Gemini 3 Flash for Rovo

source.label: Atlassian 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Atlassian strengthened its strategic partnership with Google Cloud by adding Gemini 3 Flash to its open, multi-model AI strategy and extending its agentic AI capabilities – enabling advanced reasoning and multimodal features for Rovo at enterprise scale.

relations.text: Dropboxの年次報告が、Atlassianを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Atlassian as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Dropbox 10-K
source.quote: Certain features of our platform compete in the cloud storage market with products offered by Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Google, and Adobe and in the content collaboration market with products offered by Microsoft, Atlassian, Slack (now part of Salesforce) and Google.

relations.text: Dynatraceの年次報告が、Atlassianと連携機能を開発するために提携していると述べている
relations.text_en: Dynatrace's annual report says it partners with Atlassian to develop integrations

source.label: Dynatrace 10-K
source.quote: We partner with leading innovative technology organizations such as Atlassian, Red Hat, ServiceNow, and VMware to develop integrations, best practices, and extended capabilities that help our customers and solution partners achieve faster time to market and enhanced value in dynamic multicloud environments.

relations.text: Oktaの連携ネットワークに、連携先としてAtlassianが含まれている
relations.text_en: Atlassian is included among the integrations in the Okta Integration Network

source.label: Okta 10-K
source.quote: The Okta Integration Network contains over 7,000 integrations with cloud, mobile and web applications, IoT devices and IT infrastructure providers, including AWS, Atlassian, DocuSign, Google, Microsoft 365, NetSuite, Oracle, Palo Alto Networks, Proofpoint, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Slack, Splunk, VMware, Workday, Zendesk and Zoom.

relations.text: 2023年からOpenAIとの提携を続けていると説明している
relations.text_en: Describes a partnership with OpenAI that began in 2023

source.label: Atlassian — OpenAI strategic partnership update, October 6, 2026
source.label_en: Atlassian — OpenAI strategic partnership update, October 6, 2026
source.quote: And in the time since our initial partnership in 2023, more than 2.5 million businesses are using OpenAI products.

relations.text: Atlassian MarketplaceでClaude Agent for Jiraを提供している
relations.text_en: Offers Claude Agent for Jira on the Atlassian Marketplace

source.label: Atlassian — Claude Agent for Jira availability, June 18, 2026
source.label_en: Atlassian — Claude Agent for Jira availability, June 18, 2026
source.quote: Install Claude Agent for Jira from the Atlassian Marketplace, connect your Anthropic API key and GitHub service account, and assign your first work item.

relations.text: Freshworksの年次報告が、Atlassianを競合として挙げている

source.quote: For our employee experience products, we face competition from traditional IT service management vendors such as ServiceNow, BMC, and Ivanti, as well as modern cloud-based providers, including Atlassian and various mid-market and emerging ITSM platforms.
